title: uplytics: uptime monitoring and website analytics
excerpt: Uptime monitoring, cookie-free analytics and your own data in one dashboard. Checks every 30 seconds. Start free.

Monitoring

Know it's down before your customers do.

Point uplytics at a page, an API, a server port or a cron job. It checks every minute and only pages you when a failure is confirmed.

  • Six kinds of checkHTTP(s), keyword on a page, TCP port, ping, DNS records and heartbeats for cron jobs and workers.
  • No false alarmsFailures are re-checked before an alert goes out, and maintenance windows keep planned work quiet.
  • SSL and response timesCertificate expiry warnings, 24-hour response time charts and 90 days of daily uptime.

When something goes down, every open uplytics tab takes over the screen, and your team hears about it on the channels they already watch. When it comes back, you get the all-clear with how long it was down.

Your data

Chart the numbers behind your website.

Payments, signups, orders, bookings: send any records as JSON to a private URL, or let uplytics pull them from your API. It finds the numbers, statuses and dates on its own and charts them next to your traffic and uptime.

  • Totals for today, this week, this month or any dates, compared with the period before
  • Breakdowns by any field you send, like plan, status or country
  • Search and filter every record; open one to see all its fields

Questions, answered

Do I need a credit card to start?

No. Every new account gets 14 days of Pro for free. Afterwards, choose a plan or stay on Free; nothing is deleted either way.

What happens if I go over my plan?

Pageviews are a soft limit: tracking never stops and we'll suggest a bigger plan. For websites, monitors and status pages, you can't add more until you upgrade or remove some.

Do teammates cost extra?

No per-seat pricing. Each plan includes a number of people who can make changes, and anyone who only needs to look can join as a free viewer.

Is the analytics really cookie-free?

Yes. uplytics sets no cookies and stores no IP addresses. Visitors are counted with a hash that changes every day, so nobody can be followed across days or sites, and there's no consent banner to show.

What can I monitor?

Websites and APIs over HTTP(s), text on a page, TCP ports such as databases or mail servers, ping, DNS records, and cron jobs or workers that send a heartbeat.

How often are things checked?

As often as every 30 seconds on Pro and Business, every minute on Starter and every 5 minutes on Free. You choose per monitor, up to every hour, or how often a heartbeat should arrive.

Will I get woken up by false alarms?

Failures are re-checked before an alert is sent, you choose how many failures in a row count as down, and maintenance windows silence planned work.

Can I bring my own data, like payments or signups?

Yes. Send any JSON to your private URL, or give uplytics an API to read from. Each kind of data gets its own page; uplytics finds the numbers, statuses and dates on its own, and you can adjust them.

Can my users see when something is down?

Yes. Create a public status page with the services you choose and 90 days of history.

Stop finding out from your customers.

Add your website and get your first check in under a minute. Uptime, visitors and your data, all on one screen.

问题，已解答

Do I need a credit card to start?

No. Every new account gets 14 days of Pro for free. Afterwards, choose a plan or stay on Free; nothing is deleted either way.

What happens if I go over my plan?

Pageviews are a soft limit: tracking never stops and we'll suggest a bigger plan. For websites, monitors and status pages, you can't add more until you upgrade or remove some.

Do teammates cost extra?

No per-seat pricing. Each plan includes a number of people who can make changes, and anyone who only needs to look can join as a free viewer.

Is the analytics really cookie-free?

是的。 uplytics sets no cookies and stores no IP addresses. Visitors are counted with a hash that changes every day, so nobody can be followed across days or sites, and there's no consent banner to show.

What can I monitor?

Websites and APIs over HTTP(s), text on a page, TCP ports such as databases or mail servers, ping, DNS records, and cron jobs or workers that send a heartbeat.

How often are things checked?

As often as every 30 seconds on Pro and Business, every minute on Starter and every 5 minutes on Free. You choose per monitor, up to every hour, or how often a heartbeat should arrive.

Will I get woken up by false alarms?

Failures are re-checked before an alert is sent, you choose how many failures in a row count as down, and maintenance windows silence planned work.

Can I bring my own data, like payments or signups?

是的。 Send any JSON to your private URL, or give uplytics an API to read from. Each kind of data gets its own page; uplytics finds the numbers, statuses and dates on its own, and you can adjust them.

Can my users see when something is down?

是的。 Create a public status page with the services you choose and 90 days of history.
